findings.evidence: Caribou Coffee uses pixels, or transparent GIF files, to help manage online advertising. These GIF files are provided by our ad management partner, DoubleClick. These files enable DoubleClick to recognize a unique cookie on your Web browser, which in turn enables us to learn which advertisements bring users to our website. The cookie was placed by us, or by another advertiser who works with DoubleClick.
findings.rationale: The policy mentions automatic collection of IP addresses but does not explicitly state sharing with Google AdMob or any other named entity.
The policy does not comply with the prohibition against tracking and targeted advertising for children.
